units.source_text: 到了竹林前面，我就骗他们说宝贝就在这里埋着呢。

en.t: When we reached the front of the bamboo grove, I tricked them by saying the treasure was buried right here.

units.source_text: 男的贪图小利，当然着急进去。

en.t: The man was greedy for a small gain, so of course he was eager to go in.

units.source_text: 但是那个女人根本没下马，坚持在外面等着。

en.t: But the woman never got down from her horse at all and insisted on waiting outside.

units.source_text: 我估计她是看竹林灌木密集，才会这么说。

en.t: I suppose she said that because she saw how dense the shrubs were in the bamboo grove.

units.source_text: 说真的，这正中我下怀，把女人留在外面，我跟那男人一起进了竹林。

en.t: To tell the truth, that suited me perfectly, so I left the woman outside and went into the bamboo grove with the man.
